task: Each source has two targets: finite2 with new response parameters, or recurrent with the original response parameters. Both targets share paid prefix controls. Private family labels and seeds appear only in the experiment protocol/results.

intervention: Expose existing refitting and measured instrument/response research directions through Python research_choice. The host does not select a repair using hidden family labels, numerical error, or terminal outcomes.
controller: At most 12 research_choice invocations, each followed only by its returned next_action. The first choice receives the actual archived source path; subsequent choices use their default candidate handling. The controller does not inspect MSE or private task kind to select research actions. Stop after confirmed submission, no next action, or 12 choice rounds. Twelve offline rounds allow 12 choices plus at most 12 returned actions; they are not the live arm's 12 model calls.
archive_publication: New predictors retain ordinary code, data and binary dependencies. Imported confirmed-model archives accompany them only when declared in the successful finish.reused_files. Runner logs and the undeclared candidate catalog are excluded. An unchanged directly submitted archive keeps its existing dependencies. Revisions to an inherited model publish a new candidate. A latest predictor explicitly depending on an older candidate retains that dependency, which is reported.
failure_policy: Keep every registered target and service failure; no replacement or retry.
accounting: Existing source-learning costs reported once separately; no new source learning. Targets include every paid observation and executed action. No treatment comparison or advantage claim.
terminal_order: Every source and target stops learning before any 128-row terminal evaluation. Source admission uses fresh confirmation only, never terminal outcomes.
scope: Development replay of the same two source apparatuses and four target tasks previously used by the live Python-refit pilot and threshold-disclosure replay. These are not new independent samples. Offline routing is a deterministic recommendation consumer, not evidence of autonomous LLM adoption.
model_identity: gpt-6-luna is requested through the existing subscription provider. Usage metadata repeating that name does not independently establish server routing.
